Ali Ali Karna Sajjad Ashraf Taqvi Lyrics
Khuda Ko Lagta Hai Pyara Ali Ali Karna.
Hai Anbiya Ka Wazeefa Ali Ali Karna.
Sukhan Warron Ki Safon Ka Imam Hai Meesum.
Aik Aisay Ashiq-e-Maula Ka Naam Hai Meesum.
Jo Daar Par Bhi Na Bhola Ali Ali Karna.
Woh Dil Hi Kya Jo Wilaye Ali Se Khali Hai.
Main Kaisay Maan Loon Oss Shaks Ko Halali Hai.
Nahi Hai Jis Ko Gawara Ali Ali Karna.
Safon Mein Rakhta Hai Banday Ko Sarfarazon Ki.
Qaboliyat Ka Hai Zamin Yehi Namazon Ki.
Bicha Bicha Ke Musalla Ali Ali Karna.
Ali Ke Ishq Ka Yeh Sar Pe Taj Rakhtay Hain.
Youn Hi Tu Apne Zamane Pe Raaj Rakhtay Hain.
Qalandaron Ka Hai Shewah Ali Ali Karna.
Bara Sawab Hai Jis Ka Yeh Woh Ibadat Hai.
Yeh Woh Amal Hai Jo Paigambaron Ki Sunat Hai.
Humein Nabi Ne Sikhaya Ali Ali Karna.
Ali Se Mangtay Rehna Qadam Qadam Imdad.
Balaein Pas Na Aaein Gi Akhtar-o- Sajjad.
Yeh Mashwara Hai Hamesha Ali Ali Karna.
